anti_regression_invariants.rule: TOKEN_VAZIO must never be coerced to zero, false, null, PASS or FAIL.
claim_allowed must remain false in this contract and every governed snapshot.
Public accessibility must never imply public-domain status.
license_verified requires concrete license evidence references.
redistribution_allowed requires an explicit verified redistribution grant.
training_allowed requires an explicit verified training or ML-use grant.
commercial_use_allowed requires an explicit verified commercial-use grant.
Upstream and asset-specific terms take precedence over repository defaults.
Third-party material must be tracked separately from original material.
Every unresolved uncertainty requires an accountable owner or authority.
Every unresolved uncertainty requires a concrete next_action.
Every unresolved uncertainty requires an objective exit_criterion.
Resolved or evidenced states require evidence_refs.
Negative evidence is a valid scoped outcome and must not be rewritten as success.
A hash proves integrity of represented bytes, not truth of the represented claim.
CI execution must never be used as proof of physical Android or Termux execution.
Repeated execution in the same controlled runner is not independent replication.
A cron trigger is scheduling metadata, not evidence.
A parable or metaphor may index a concept but may not become a physical mechanism by wording.
Operational scores or maturity labels are not probabilities of truth.
High-risk or critical actions require explicit human review.
Every use must declare a bounded purpose.
Every use must minimize copied data to what is necessary for its declared purpose.
Any mutating action requires a rollback or recovery reference before execution.
Automatic merge is forbidden by this governance contract.
Direct mutation of protected canonical branches is forbidden by this contract.
Historical receipts are append-only; correction creates successors rather than rewriting evidence.
Every decision requires provenance sufficient to identify its source surface and observation.
Temporal ordering and supersession must be explicit; a later record cannot silently rewrite an earlier event.
Conflicting evidence remains explicit uncertainty until a discriminating test resolves the conflict.
